faqs.q: How do I apply for a limited liquor licence?
faqs.a: You can apply for a limited liquor licence depending on the type of function you are holding. Options include single functions, multiple functions, special events, and trade fairs.

faqs.q: What if I need to check an existing licence?
faqs.a: You can check a limited liquor licence (single or multi-function) using the dedicated service.

faqs.q: Do I need to notify the functions I will be running?
faqs.a: Yes, you can submit a limited liquor licence functions notification.
